newsitem.title: INDIA: Higher supplies drags down Indian sugar prices.
newsitem.headline: Higher supplies drags down Indian sugar prices.

text.p: Low consumer demand and higher supplies dragged down Indian sugar prices on Monday, dealers said.

In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 5-8 rupees to 1,350/1,380 rupees per quintal while M-30 eased by five rupees to 1,380/1,438 rupees. Sugar mill delivery fell to 1,280/1,295 rupees from 1,295/1,305.
"Supplies were higher due to fresh offerings by mill owners and sentiments at the close remained subdued amid lower than expected festival buying," one broker said.
